problems.problem: Background lacks luxury texture and dramatic lighting. The burgundy wall appears flat with inconsistent lighting, failing to match the polished, chiaroscuro style of high-end campaigns. The floor's wood grain is visible but lacks the rich, reflective quality needed for luxury.

The composition is generic compared to references. Unlike the integrated, concept-driven layouts of Byredo (image 4) or Armani/Prive (image 5), the poster separates the bottle from typography with excessive negative space, reducing visual impact.
Lighting and background elements are disconnected. The hard side light on the bottle clashes with the soft, diffused wall lighting, creating visual inconsistency that undermines the luxury concept.

changes.value: Deep burgundy velvet wall with rich, tactile texture meeting a polished mahogany floor with warm, reflective grain, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting casting sharp diagonal shadows, luxurious interior with warm ambient glow, no studio equipment visible
